rules.gap: Not yet coded (issue #916): the library holds Chapter II-2 as revised by MSC.99(73) in 2000, which carries this paragraph, but not the amendments since, so the current text has not been read. No limit is given. The model places no escape routes. Named for a reviewer. Consequence `note`: it names a requirement the model cannot yet check, and warns of no failure (the airlock and V/22.1.3 gap rows are `warn` because their Rules carry a limit that the model could not work out; these two carry none)
